content.text:
The quest The Pale Harvest is complete, and I've given the final notes.

I killed the drowned sailor and the Drowned Captain in the wreck, took the captain's strongbox key and opened the strongbox. Inside was a Kothringi Keystone on a chain. I took it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, and she paid me 100 gold.

She doesn't know what the keystone does. She says the Chime-Keepers of Toklea, in the Tulmek Washes, keep what is left of Kothringi lore, and their elder will know. She also knew the Unbound had never found the wreck, and I don't know how.

Cuts-the-Old-Knot, seal paste, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel and what the keystone opens are all still unknown. The next step is to take the keystone to Toklea.
